volume_basis.source: Mass-specific V=1/rho in Rankine-Hugoniot equations; ambient V0 at 300 K. Cold BM3 uses a distinct Vc at 0 K, which is not tabulated.
volume_basis.public: Conventional fcc cell, four Pt atoms; molar mass 195.084 g/mol is a conversion convention.

equations.cold: BM3 with Vc, B0_0K=288.4 and B0_prime_0K=5.05

equations.electronic: Recovered Tsuchiya-Kawamura (2002) Table I Pt electronic pressure, absolute 0 K reference; all 51 nodes bundled and unchanged by the Au-only erratum.

missing_dependencies.need: Unrounded author cold Vc, phonon normalization and adopted electronic implementation for exact author-model reproduction. The separate PVT reconstruction includes an explicitly derived residual-pressure correction.

table5.phase_annotation: Parentheses indicate first liquid states by the preceding Table III convention; two Pt entries at 3000 K (V/V0=1.00,0.98) are parenthesized. The Pt caption does not restate this convention.

upstream_inputs.role: Seven recovered new experiments from the Holmes (1989) source; not necessarily the full Yokoo selection, which is not enumerated. Shock pressure follows momentum conservation; Ta impedance-match/calibration and 2-sigma errors retained in the upstream audit.

36 simultaneous Au/Pt volume pairs are recoverable from the underlying source table, with separate Au and Pt files. Ruby-scale pressure is comparison metadata, not a Yokoo fitting target. Fig. 6 checks mutual Au/Pt consistency, not an independent primary pressure measurement.
Ambient thermal expansion, specific heat and elastic measurements
upstream_inputs.recovery: Not supplied as numerical Pt tables in Yokoo; raw rows, weights, exact selection and covariance unavailable.

fit_scope: Section II.D: three adjustable B0_prime_0K, a, b; gamma0 obtained secondarily; simultaneous steepest-descent least squares with respect to total pressures. Details delegated to Tange (2009), no row-level weights/selection or complete Pt inputs here.

electronic_source.inspection: Equations (1)-(6), DOS/energy discussion, Table I/Figures 3-5 and the complete erratum inspected visually on 2026-10-09.
electronic_source.pressure_reference: Raw Pt electronic pressure relative to 0 K; Pt 300 K value is 0.04 GPa. The absolute Yokoo decomposition does not subtract this value.
electronic_source.volume_dependence: Near volume independence inferred by linear free-energy fitting within the calculated volume range; not a numerical volume-resolved energy table or proof at arbitrary compression.
electronic_source.erratum_scope: Nine Au nodes corrected at 3100-3900 K; no Pt values corrected.
electronic_source.interpolation_rule: Linear interpolation is an explicit implementation choice for the bounded PVT reconstruction; source prescription is unspecified.
electronic_source.electronic_energy: DOS-integral equations and energy/free-energy curves given; no complete numeric Eel(V,T) or DOS grid available for original shock replay.
